name: test-support-helper-chain
description: Code that only tests reach is test code however many helpers lie between it and the test. A helper a test calls and a helper only that helper calls are live, and the default minimum confidence withholds what is reported about them, a production function only the second helper calls is reported as test-only use in a component of its own, because a reference from test-support code is a test reference, and a helper function nothing calls is reported under the unused code its visibility selects. In the Go rendering nothing imports the first helper package, which its own test file uses.
